# No1 Air Conditioning

> Air conditioning installer with a showroom at 10 Christchurch Road, Ringwood, Hampshire BH24 1DN. Installs, services and repairs air conditioning and air-to-air heat pumps for homes and businesses within 30 miles of Ringwood, covering Hampshire, Dorset and the New Forest. Phone 01425 333760.

- Installed from £1,999 including VAT; 0% finance available on qualifying installations.
- Brands: Mitsubishi Electric (premium recommendation), Daikin, Clivet.
- Refcom certified installers; up to 5 year warranty.
- Showroom visits available to see and hear units working before buying.
- Areas: Ringwood, Fordingbridge, Ferndown, Verwood, St Leonards, Christchurch, Wimborne, New Milton, Bournemouth, Poole, Lymington, Southampton, Salisbury, New Forest.
- Part of No1 Energy Solutions Ltd, which also trades as No1 Fires (https://no1fires.co.uk).
